trans-unit.target: TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYSTEM_100_000<tab>In order to undertake this quest, you must first meet the following requirements:

TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYSTEM_110_000<tab>1. FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail must be registered to your service account. 2. You must be a beastmaster. 3. You must have befriended at least twenty-five beasts.
TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYLMOND_000_000<tab><var 08 E905 ((Lady)) ((Ser)) /var> <var 2C ((<var 29 EB02 /var>)) (( )) 02 /var>! I have exciting news to share about the Crucible.
TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYLMOND_000_001<tab>A new board has been added! One fit for only the most talented masters of combat.

TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYLMOND_000_002<tab>Lady Lauda seems happier than ever. The souls of the Crucible are thriving, she says, and this new board affords ambitious beasts space to spread their wings─quite literally, where applicable!

TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYLMOND_000_003<tab>Furthermore, I <var 1A 02 /var>distinctly<var 1A 01 /var> heard her mention that the final challenger will be a most formidable dragon known as “Borgny the Venomous.”
TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYLMOND_000_004<tab>How's that for observation? I may yet be a fledgling of the craft, but you must admit that I have a keen sense for detail!

TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYLMOND_000_005<tab>One day I shall be venturing into the Crucible beside you, <var 08 E905 ((Lady)) ((Ser)) /var> <var 2C ((<var 29 EB02 /var>)) (( )) 02 /var>! Oh, what a day that will be... Until then, keep doing us proud!
TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYSTEM_000_020<tab>The First Master's Board has been unlocked. To challenge it, speak with Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.
TEXT_JOBXBM191_05500_SYSTEM_000_021<tab>Furthermore, new wares are now available from the Kornago merchant.
